name: pwdev-prd
description: Interview-driven PRDs with an approval gate, a roadmap with an explicit dependency chain (waves and critical path, validated by a deterministic checker), canonical JSON export, and publishing to GitHub Projects through pwdev-github.

interface.longDescription: Write a technology-agnostic PRD through a 12-step interview with one question at a time and an approval gate, decompose the approved PRD into phases, epics, features and tasks with explicit dependencies, waves and a critical path checked by a deterministic validator, and publish the roadmap to a GitHub Project with issues and blocked-by links.
defaultPrompt: Interview me to write a PRD for this feature.
Turn the approved PRD into a roadmap with its dependency chain.
Publish the approved roadmap to a GitHub Project.
